title: intraday_feed record (canonical, v1)
description: One symbol at one feed event, as received. Every intraday feed adapter (E*TRADE watchlist) publishes these rows to the Redis stream mtap:evt:INTRADAY_FEED, batched in the envelope under definitions.batch. A feed fills only what it has; anything else is absent or null. See intraday_feed.md for the per-feed field mapping.

symbol.description: Ticker as the feed reports it.

ts_utc.description: Event time, ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds. For snapshot feeds this is the poll time.

kind.description: snapshot: a point-in-time quote poll (cumulative volume). agg_*: an interval aggregate (interval OHLC + volume).

feed_seq.description: Per-source batch sequence, monotonic within one adapter process.

price.description: Last trade price (snapshot) or the interval close (agg).

vwap_session.description: The feed's own session VWAP so far, if it publishes one.

day_open.description: Today's official open; null before the open.

trades_i.description: Trades in the interval (agg feeds only).

vol_10d_src.description: The feed's own 10-day average volume (E*TRADE MAIN only); a cross-check, not a model input.

batch.description: One Redis stream entry: the rows of one poll. The Bus adds _key and _ts.
